generationRequest.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated 2D game environment sprite on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, reference-guided redraw. Image1 supplies intended organ material and shape language; Image2 is the established delivered asset's matte gouache, clean dark ink contours, fine hand-painted texture and side-view only, do not copy its anatomy. Side-scrolling camera, very slight top-face visibility only where appropriate. Draw one complete coherent object with about 8% clear transparent padding, no scene, no floating multiple objects, no contact shadow or colored haze outside the silhouette. Full object uncropped. No characters, creatures, shelters, lamps, red ropes, rewards, symbols, labels, UI, ground patch, water or backdrop. No human stonework or invented portals.  Subject: ONE reusable cranial bone platform module for dead whale R5 head, 8 hero units wide. A long worn ivory-gray skull plate ledge with a broad gently irregular stable horizontal top, subtly bright contact rim, lower side wall is a curved sheet of cranial bone with long shallow striations and only sparse small pores. A few very short attached dark membrane threads below; no plants. Broad slab form, not repeating circular vertebrae, no rib bones, ear spiral, hollow tunnel, portal, gate, ladder, glyph or tools. Muted coolblue shadows with old warm ivory surface, matte handpainted style. About4:1 profile, fully intact complete object.
